title: State Tax on Released Survivor Shares of Income Annuities Installments, by State of Issue
content:
Iowa, Minnesota, North Carolina, Vermont — **5% (0.05)**; Delaware, New York, Oklahoma — **4% (0.04)**: these are the state tax rates on the taxable part of a survivor share released from an installment held on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract.

**Condition.** State tax is withheld from the released survivor share only when federal tax is withheld from it and federal tax was withheld from the contract's installments falling due in the twelve months before the release (the federal tax withheld on installments issued for payment dates in those twelve months totals more than zero). Then it is withheld at the state flat rate of 5% on the taxable part for a contract issued in Iowa, Minnesota, North Carolina or Vermont, and at the alternative state rate of 4% on the taxable part for a contract issued in Delaware, New York or Oklahoma, rounded to the cent. Otherwise no state tax is withheld from the released survivor share.

| Federal tax on the released share | Federal tax on installments due in the prior twelve months | Minnesota contract | Oklahoma contract | Texas contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Withheld | Withheld | 5% | 4% | None |
| Withheld | None | None | None | None |
| None | Withheld | None | None | None |

*Hypothetical figure.* Taxable part $1,400.00 with both conditions met: Minnesota $70.00, Oklahoma $56.00.
